meta.name: adversarial-reviewer
meta.description: Adversarial code review that breaks the self-review monoculture. Use when you want a genuinely critical review of recent changes, before merging a PR, or when you suspect Claude is being too agreeable about code quality. Forces perspective shifts through hostile reviewer personas that catch blind spots the author's mental model shares with the reviewer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在合并前获得真正挑剔的代码审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望代码审查能发现盲点，避免自我审查的盲区
copy.tagline_en: Get genuinely critical code reviews before merging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want code reviews that catch blind spots and avoid self-review bias

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会扮演三个挑剔的审查者（破坏者、新人、安全审计员），对代码变更进行严格审查，找出至少一个问题，并给出阻止合并、有顾虑或干净的结论。
howto.when: 当你要求审查代码变更时触发，例如在合并 PR 前、长时间编码后，或当 Claude 对代码质量过于乐观时。

say.text: 请对抗性审查我最近的代码变更。
say.note: Claude 会运行三个审查者角色并输出结构化报告。

say.text: 对抗性审查最后三次提交。
say.note: Claude 会审查最近三个提交的差异。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as three adversarial reviewers (Saboteur, New Hire, Security Auditor) to critically examine code changes, finding at least one issue each, and produces a verdict: BLOCK, CONCERNS, or CLEAN.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a code review, e.g., before merging a PR, after a long coding session, or when Claude seems too agreeable about code quality.

say_en.text: Adversarially review my recent code changes.
say_en.note: Claude runs three personas and outputs a structured report.

say_en.text: Adversarial review of the last three commits.
say_en.note: Claude reviews the diff of the last three commits.
